gen-gf-cambo-manrope: Manrope draws round bowls with walls that never swell, and its bright open curves sit under Cambo's brushy, moderately modulated serif headings. Its sharpest trait is the stroke: brushed above, uniform below.
gen-gf-cambo-montserrat: Old ink, new wire: Cambo's serif headings keep hairlines only a touch lighter than stems. Cambo gives the editorial voice, and Montserrat glides under the eye with oversized e and a counters.
gen-gf-cambo-satoshi: Satoshi stands tall on a soaring x-height, every stroke uniform, its e never squeezed shut. And Cambo's moderately modulated serif letters make the real difference, traditional where Satoshi is plain.
gen-gf-cambo-switzer: Cambo brings a brushy, traditional serif voice with slight but visible thick-thin variation, over Switzer's tubular, wire-like letterforms. Paragraphs in Switzer run rope-consistent, with tips that never creep shut.
gen-gf-candal-fs-erode: Erode sets a tall middle band with shallow ascenders and descenders, its g and a broad and open. Candal, with latched, closed curves, handles the modern punch while Erode handles the dignified reading.
gen-gf-carlito-fs-erode: Dignified and editorial, this body voice ebbs and flows with a hint of wedge pressure in each curve. Erode does the patient reading, while Carlito, tight-set with a tall x-height, does the contemporary headline work.
gen-gf-carlito-fs-karma: Trustworthy is Karma's manner, its terminals finishing well away from the stem. Carlito's low-contrast, tightly spaced headings lead the way, then Karma takes over with a gentle shift from heavier to lighter strokes.
gen-gf-carrois-gothic-fs-erode: Modern edge, dignified body: Carrois Gothic keeps its cap-to-lowercase step minimal while Erode's text serif ebbs and flows. Carrois Gothic leads briskly, and Erode settles in to do the reading.
gen-gf-carrois-gothic-fs-karma: Crisp meets classic: Carrois Gothic keeps a minimal cap-to-lowercase step, while Karma's text serif holds stems just above hairlines. And Carrois Gothic earns its keep big and short, where that open s counter can show.
gen-gf-carrois-gothic-sc-fs-karma: Karma brings trustworthy, classic text with a calm modulation, tucked beneath the open-ended curves of Carrois Gothic SC. Nothing snags the eye as the lines roll steadily along, paragraph after paragraph.
